text:
Dark mode is here 🌙

It went live for all users on May 12. Nearly 40% of our beta testers asked for it, so thank you for telling us.

We spent a lot of time on readability. Text in dark mode has a 7:1 contrast ratio, which is the WCAG AAA level for body text. Your notes stay easy to read whether you're writing at midnight or in a sunny café. Dark mode also cuts glare on late nights, and switching between light and dark takes a single tap.

To try it, open Settings and pick the theme you like.

Thanks for helping us build this, and keep the notes coming!
